cases.name: Beza, the Bounding Spring
cases.text: When Beza enters, create a Treasure token if an opponent controls more lands than you. If an opponent has more life than you, you gain 4 life. If an opponent controls more creatures than you, create two 1/1 blue Fish creature tokens. If an opponent has more cards in hand than you, draw a card.

cases.name: Guarded arrivals
cases.text: When this creature enters, create three Treasure tokens if an opponent controls more creatures than you. If an opponent has more life than you, you gain 6 life. If an opponent has more cards in hand than you, draw two cards.

cases.name: Guarded reserves
cases.text: When this creature enters, draw a card if an opponent has more cards in hand than you. If an opponent controls more lands than you, create a Treasure token.
